how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-timbermaw-hold-01-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:6031:details:0: In Timbermaw, we are content. We do not like strangers. This is good for us, but it is bad for trade.
rows.quest:6031:details:1: Not long ago, a rare night elf friend came to Timbermaw and she wore a runecloth cloak. ⟦E1⟧ is rare among us, but the cloak was so fine my people want me to make more runecloth clothing.
rows.quest:6031:details:2: Will you bring me runecloth? If you bring me enough, then I will give you something in trade.
rows.quest:6031:progress:0: Do you have the runecloth?  My people are eager for more items of runecloth!
rows.quest:6031:completion:0: Ah, you brought the cloth. Such fine material it is!
rows.quest:6031:completion:1: Thank you, ⟦1⟧. You are a true friend. Please accept this in exchange.
rows.quest:6032:details:0: Although the people of Timbermaw delight in the feel of runecloth, it is not sacred to us. But mooncloth is sacred.
rows.quest:6032:details:1: Bring me a small supply of this holy cloth, and I will teach you a secret fashioning technique.
rows.quest:6032:completion:0: Ah, very good. This mooncloth will be used for garments sacred to our people. Thank you, ⟦3⟧. Now I will train you.
rows.quest:8461:obj:0: ⟦E5⟧ would like you to kill 6 ⟦E6⟧ Den Watchers, 6 ⟦E6⟧ Avengers, and 6 ⟦E6⟧ Shamans. Return to him in northern ⟦E7⟧ near the entrance to Timbermaw Hold.

rows.quest:8461:details:1: The ⟦E6⟧ tribe is evil, but it is the effects of the fel that pollutes their minds. Their hostility is not truly an innate quality, yet they cannot be helped. It saddens me that we must fight our own brethren.
rows.quest:8461:details:2: Please, ⟦4⟧ - I ask you to do what must be done. Simply spare me the details; such troublesome images upset me far too much.
rows.quest:8461:progress:0: Once you gain the trust of the Timbermaw, I am confident there will be something we will be able to do for you. The Timbermaw do not forget their allies, especially in dark times such as these.
rows.quest:8461:completion:0: I sense that you have achieved victory. Victory... such a hollow word considering what had to be done. Regardless, you've proven yourself to be worthy of our trust.
rows.quest:8461:completion:1: It may take some time before the Timbermaw welcome you without hostility within the Hold. Still, your perseverance will erode any suspicion my brethren may have about you. So long as you never betray us and raise weapons against us, we will find common ground.
rows.quest:8464:obj:0: ⟦E10⟧ wants you to kill 8 ⟦E11⟧, 8 Winterfall Den Watchers, and 8 ⟦E12⟧. ⟦E10⟧ is located just outside the entrance to Timbermaw Hold in ⟦E13⟧.
rows.quest:8464:details:0: The Timbermaw tend to stay to themselves, ⟦5⟧. While we do allow safe passage to those we trust, we try to avoid other furbolg tribes if at all possible.
rows.quest:8464:details:1: The Winterfall tribe as of late has become increasingly hostile towards us. They seem to be in a state of rage, completely engulfed by their own fear and hatred of anything they do not understand.
rows.quest:8464:details:2: I must ask you to thin their numbers as to lessen the threat against us. Seek them out in Winterfall Village, far to the east of here.
rows.quest:8464:progress:0: We very much appreciate what you have done for the Timbermaw, ⟦6⟧. Your continued efforts will surely earn my tribe's trust and respect.
rows.quest:8464:completion:0: Thank you for what you have done, as saddening as it is. Accept this as a token of thanks.
rows.quest:8464:completion:1: I would ask of you to please continue helping us, ⟦7⟧. We have very few allies on which to call upon, and without your aid, the threats against my tribe would surely be too much for us to handle alone.
